lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chetahi tin balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who remember the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad tin mel milaau ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I unite in Union with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲਾਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee dhoor laaee mukh masatak satasa(n)gat bahi gun gaaidaa ||2||
lines.translation: I touch the dust of their feet to my face and forehead; sitting in the Society of the Saints, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke gun gaavaa je har prabh bhaavaa ||
lines.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, as I am pleasing to the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar har naam sabad suhaavaa ||
lines.translation: With the Lord's Name deep within my inner being, I am adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee chahu ku(n)dee suneeai saachai naam samaaidaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Bani is heard throughout the four corners of the world; through it, we merge in the True Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan saachaa j a(n)tar bhaale ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who searches within himself,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad har nadar nihaale ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sees the Lord with his eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: giaan a(n)jan paae gurasabadee nadaree nadar milaaidaa ||4||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Shabad, he applies the ointment of spiritual wisdom to his eyes; the Gracious Lord, in His Grace, unites him with Himself. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag ihu sareer paaiaa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I obtained this body;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam sabad chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: in this human life, I have focused my consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਦਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai sabh a(n)dh a(n)dheraa guramukh kisahi bujhaaidaa ||5||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, everything is enveloped in utter darkness; only the Gurmukh understands. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kit aae janam gavaae ||
lines.translation: Some merely waste away their lives - why have they even come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh laage doojai bhaae ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are attached to the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: eh velaa phir haath na aavai pag khisiai pachhutaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: This opportunity shall not into their hands again; their foot slips, and they come to regret and repent. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pavitr sareeraa ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the body is sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich vasai sach gunee gaheeraa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord, the ocean of virtue, dwells within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sach vekhai sabh thaaee sach sun ma(n)n vasaaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: One who sees the Truest of the True everywhere, hears the Truth, and enshrines it within his mind. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai ganat gur sabad nivaare ||
lines.translation: Egotism and mental calculations are relieved through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu hiradai rakhahu ur dhaare ||
lines.translation: Keep the Dear Lord close, and enshrine Him in your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa saalaahe mil saache sukh paaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: One who praises the Lord forever, through the Guru's Shabad, meets with the True Lord, and finds peace. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਚੇਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਚੇਤਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so chete jis aap chetaae ||
lines.translation: He alone remembers the Lord, whom the Lord inspires to remember.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad vasai man aae ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: aape vekhai aape boojhai aapai aap samaaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: He Himself sees, and He Himself understands; He merges all into Himself. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin man vich vath paaee soee jaanai ||
lines.translation: He alone knows, who has placed the object within his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabade aap pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: aap pachhaanai soee jan niramal baanee sabad sunaaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: That humble being who understands himself is immaculate. He proclaims the Guru's Bani, and the Word of the Shabad. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh kaaiaa pavit hai sareer ||
lines.translation: This body is sanctified and purified;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚੇਤੈ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee chetai gunee gaheer ||
lines.translation: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it contemplates the Lord, the ocean of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gun gaavai ra(n)g raataa gun kahi gunee samaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: One who chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord night and day, and remains attuned to His Love, chants His Glorious Virtues, immersed in the Glorious Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu sareer sabh mool hai maaiaa ||
lines.translation: This body is the source of all Maya;

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bharam bhulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: in love with duality, it is deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: har na chetai sadaa dukh paae bin har chete dukh paaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: It does not remember the Lord, and suffers in eternal pain. Without remembering the Lord, it suffers in pain. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: j satigur seve so paravaan ||
lines.translation: One who serves the True Guru is approved and respected.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s niramal dar sachai jaan ||
lines.translation: His body and soul-swan are immaculate and pure; in the Court of the Lord, he is known to be true.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸੋਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: har seve har ma(n)n vasaae sohai har gun gaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: He serves the Lord, and enshrines the Lord in his mind; he is exalted, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa gur seviaa na jaai ||
lines.translation: Without good destiny, no one can serve the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhoole mue bilalaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, and die weeping and wailing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau nadar hovai gur keree har jeeu aap milaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed by the Guru's Glance of Grace - the Dear Lord unites them with Himself. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਪਕੇ ਹਟਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kot pake hatanaale ||
lines.translation: In the body fortress, are the solidly-constructed markets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੇਵੈ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh levai vasat samaale ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh purchases the object, and takes care of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa naam dhiaai din raatee ootam padavee paaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, day and night, he attains the sublime, exalted status. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sachaa hai sukhadaataa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself is the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur kai sabad pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad of the Perfect Guru, He is realized.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੭॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahe saachaa poorai bhaag ko paaidaa ||16||7||21||
lines.translation: Nanak praises the Naam, the True Name of the Lord; through perfect destiny, He is found. ||16||7||21||
